title: 作り込み B：居住区画と管制室
theme: furnishings and details in the living quarters and control room of a Japanese underground research station, realistic photographic PBR materials, soft even daylight, muted natural colours, moderate contrast, not too dark and not oversaturated

cells.name: 自販機の赤い塗装
cells.prompt: red painted steel vending machine side panel, smooth satin paint with faint scuffs, straight-on, about 1 m across

cells.name: 金屏風
cells.prompt: Japanese folding screen painting on soft gold leaf squares: an old pine tree and two cranes, gentle traditional style, faint grid of gold leaf joints, no text, no seals, filling the whole square

cells.name: 畳んだ布団
cells.prompt: side view of a neat stack of folded Japanese futons and quilts with indigo, white and soft red patterned covers, no text, filling the whole square

cells.name: ワインラック
cells.prompt: front view of a dark wooden wine rack with square cubbies holding the round ends of wine bottles in green and brown glass, no labels, no text, filling the whole square

cells.name: 廊下のキリム敷物
cells.prompt: hand woven kilim rug with a geometric diamond pattern in faded terracotta, cream and indigo, seen from directly above, about 1 m across

cells.name: 掲示板
cells.prompt: front view of a cork notice board with pinned blank papers, photos of mountains and caves, a calendar grid without numbers and coloured pins, no readable text, no letters, filling the whole square

cells.name: サーバーの前面
cells.prompt: front view of a black server rack full of stacked rack-mounted servers with small green and blue status lights and ventilation grilles, no text, no logos, filling the whole square

cells.name: 上着掛け
cells.prompt: front view of a wall coat rack with hanging jackets, an orange high visibility vest, a hard hat and a canvas bag on wooden hooks against a plain wall, no text, filling the whole square

cells.name: 木版画の風景
cells.prompt: Japanese style woodblock print of misty mountains, a river and a small boat, soft blue and green tones on cream paper, no text, no seals, no signature, filling the whole square
